title: Contract Administrator
description:
We are seeking a Contract Administrator to manage and administer contracts, subcontracts, and purchase agreements across our engineering and construction projects, ensuring compliance and smooth coordination between project, finance, and legal teams.

Key Responsibilities:
* Prepare, review, and administer contracts, subcontracts, and purchase agreements in line with company and project requirements.
* Monitor contract compliance, deadlines, and deliverables across active projects.
* Draft and issue contract correspondence, including variations, extensions of time, and notices.
* Coordinate with project managers, finance, and legal teams to resolve contractual issues.
* Track and maintain accurate contract documentation, records, and registers.
* Support the preparation of tender and prequalification documentation.
* Assist in evaluating contractor/subcontractor claims and change orders.
* Ensure compliance with FIDIC and other applicable contract forms and standards.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Law, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of construction contracts and FIDIC forms.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficient in MS Office and contract management software.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

title: Accountant
description:
Maintain routine accounting procedures, including Accounts Payable (A/P), journal entries, and monthly account closures.

Key Responsibilities:
* Accountable for Bookkeeping, tax return / payable on time, issuance of tax invoice, credit notes.
* Assisting with handling petty cash and its requirement as a backup to the other team members.
* Assisting with other accounting projects.
* Assisting Manager in the preparation of monthly/yearly closings.
* Preparing and submit weekly/monthly reports.
* Updating financial data in databases to ensure that information will be accurate and immediately available when needed.
* Assisting with reviewing of expenses, payroll records etc. as assigned.
* Assisting in the processing of balance sheets, income statements and other financial statements according to legal and company accounting and financial guidelines.
* Assisting with updating accounts payable and perform reconciliations.
* Assisting with updating accounts receivable and issue invoices whilst also running of reports and preparing Statement of Accounts for Clients as and when requested.
requirements:
* Bachelor's Degree in Finance or Accounting.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in UAE.
* GAAP: 1 year (Preferred).
* CPA (Preferred).
* Salary will be determined based on experience.

title: Legal Consultant / PRO
description:
Legal Advisory Background (Min. 10 to 12 yrs. UAE Experience in similar role with Engineering / Construction Corporate Firm).

Key Responsibilities:
* Handle all company-related government documentation and procedures, including PRO & Legal Advisory related official formalities.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with government departments, regulatory bodies, and external stakeholders.
* Provide expert legal advice on contractual, commercial, and regulatory matters.
* Draft, review, and vet legal documents, MOUs, NDAs, and service agreements to safeguard company interests.
* Represent the company in official meetings, chambers, and events with governmental and private entities.
* Advise management on legal implications of corporate strategies and business decisions.
* Support tendering and business development teams in ensuring compliance with prequalification and contractual requirements.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in law, Public Administration, or a related field (master's degree preferred).
* Minimum 10 to 12 years of professional experience in similar role at UAE, including at least 5 years as a PRO or Legal Advisor within an engineering consultancy or construction sector.
* Valid UAE driving license.
* Key Competencies: strategic communication and representation; ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

title: Document Controller
description:
* Transmit, receive, record and distribute e-mail correspondence and documentation according to established procedures.
* Assist with registration, filing and control of incoming and outgoing documentation.
* Perform database input and word-processing functions.
* Assist with the reproduction of drawings, specifications and other documentation.
* Ensure that the confidentiality of sensitive information is protected.
* Keep the necessary logs and registers to track documentation / progress of work.
* Perform all other duties given by line manager.
requirements:
* One to two years' experience in document management system in an engineering or architectural firm, Freshers also welcome.
* Preferably Graduate in Civil Engineering or relevant discipline.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.
* Good English oral and writing skills.
* Analytical problem solving and organizational ability.
* Proven knowledge on document management, expertise in Excel Sheet.
* Enthusiastic, self-motivated, positive & go-getter attitude.

title: Electrical BIM Modeler
description:
We are looking for a skilled Electrical BIM Modeler to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating, managing, and updating electrical Building Information Models (BIM) to support project design, coordination, and construction activities.

Key Responsibilities:
* Develop and maintain accurate 3D BIM models for electrical systems including lighting, power distribution, fire alarm, and other electrical components.
* Collaborate with architects, engineers, and other disciplines to ensure model coordination and clash detection.
* Produce detailed drawings, schedules, and reports from the BIM model.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, standards, and codes.
* Assist in the preparation of technical documentation and as-built models.
* Support project teams during design reviews and construction phases.
* Use BIM software such as Revit, AutoCAD MEP, Navisworks, and other relevant tools.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Technology, or related field.
* Proven experience as an Electrical BIM Modeler or similar role.
* Proficient in BIM software (Revit MEP, AutoCAD MEP, Navisworks).
* Strong understanding of electrical design and construction processes.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Attention to detail and problem-solving ability.

title: Mechanical BIM Modeler
description:
We are seeking a talented Mechanical BIM Modeler to join our engineering team. The candidate will be responsible for creating and managing detailed 3D BIM models for mechanical systems to support design coordination and project delivery.

Key Responsibilities:
* Develop, update, and maintain accurate 3D BIM models for mechanical systems including HVAC, plumbing, fire protection, and other mechanical components.
* Collaborate with architects, engineers, and other disciplines to ensure proper model coordination and clash detection.
* Generate detailed drawings, schedules, and reports derived from the BIM models.
* Ensure all mechanical models comply with project requirements, standards, and codes.
* Support the preparation of technical documents and as-built models. Assist project teams during design reviews and construction phases.
* Use BIM tools such as Revit MEP, AutoCAD MEP, Navisworks, and other relevant software.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Technology, or related field.
* Proven experience in Mechanical BIM modelling or a similar role.
* Proficient in BIM software like Revit MEP, AutoCAD MEP, Navisworks.
* Strong knowledge of mechanical systems design and construction.
* Excellent teamwork and communication skills.
* Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving capabilities.

title: Electrical Design Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Electrical Engineer to join our innovative team in Abu Dhabi. In this role, you will perform the electrical design process for projects collaborating closely with multidisciplinary teams to deliver efficient, sustainable, and high-quality electrical solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
* Perform electrical design for complex projects, from concept through to detailed design and execution as per TAQA/DEWA regulations and Building Code and obtain all necessary NOC from Local Authorities.
* Develop concept design for Data/Telephone system and obtain design NOC from Du/Etisalat as per authority regulations.
* Coordinate with design team in getting approval from ADCD for Fire Alarm & Voice Evacuation system and Emergency Lighting system complying Local Authority standards and regulations.
* Extended knowledge in preparing low current system designs required for the projects matching client requirement.
* Collaborate with structural, mechanical, and architectural teams to ensure smooth integration of electrical systems into the overall design.
* Prepare and present electrical design proposals, addressing client feedback and making necessary revisions.
* Prepare technical drawings, specifications, and calculation reports for construction teams and contractors.
* Ensure that all electrical designs comply with local codes, environmental regulations, and sustainability requirements.
* Review and approve submittals, shop drawings, and as-built documentation from contractors.
requirements: Candidates should have 4 years of experience in the Abu Dhabi and must possess an equivalency certificate and ADDC/TAQA Engineer Card.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Mechanical Design Engineer to join our team, responsible for the mechanical design process for projects, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver efficient, sustainable, and high-quality mechanical solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
* Perform mechanical design (HVAC, plumbing, fire fighting/fire protection) for projects from concept through detailed design and execution, complying with local authority and building code requirements.
* Prepare load calculations, equipment selection, and system sizing for mechanical services.
* Coordinate with structural, electrical, and architectural teams to ensure smooth integration of mechanical systems into the overall design.
* Prepare technical drawings, specifications, and calculation reports for construction teams and contractors.
* Prepare and present mechanical design proposals, addressing client feedback and making necessary revisions.
* Ensure all mechanical designs comply with local codes, environmental regulations, and sustainability requirements.
* Review and approve submittals, shop drawings, and as-built documentation from contractors.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering.
* Strong knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, and fire protection system design.
* Proficiency in relevant design software (AutoCAD, Revit MEP, or similar).
* Good understanding of UAE local authority codes and regulations.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.

title: FLS Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Fire & Life Safety (FLS) Engineer to design and coordinate fire protection and life safety systems for our projects, ensuring compliance with UAE Civil Defence and international codes.

Key Responsibilities:
* Design fire alarm, fire fighting, fire suppression, and voice evacuation systems in accordance with NFPA, UAE Fire and Life Safety Code, and Local Civil Defence requirements.
* Prepare fire and life safety strategy reports, drawings, and specifications for projects.
* Liaise with Civil Defence authorities to obtain design approvals and NOCs.
* Coordinate with architectural, structural, mechanical, and electrical teams to ensure fire safety systems are properly integrated.
* Review contractor shop drawings, submittals, and as-built documentation for compliance.
* Conduct site inspections to verify installation compliance with approved designs.
* Support the preparation of technical proposals and respond to client/authority comments.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Fire Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of NFPA codes and UAE Civil Defence regulations.
* Proficiency in relevant design software (AutoCAD, Revit, hydraulic calculation tools).
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and coordination abilities.

title: Junior Design Architect (Arabic)
description:
Performs a variety of assignments such as conducting architectural studies, developing design concepts and design criteria, and preparing related reports.

Key Responsibilities:
* Reviews CAD drawings, renderings, layouts, study models, construction documents, and color boards prepared by Architectural Designers.
* Ensures compliance with applicable codes, standards, and client requirements.
* Writes construction specifications and prepares detailed requisitions for equipment and materials.
* Interfaces with suppliers as required.
* Coordinates work with engineering and construction units at project site.
* Reviews, approves, and issues detailed design and construction drawings and specifications prepared by others.
* Provides the seal and signature of a professional architect when required by statute or contract.
* Provides technical guidance to Architectural Designer/Drafters working on the same project.
* Performs other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in architecture.
* Minimum 2 to 4 years' experience in Villas, Residential Building, industrial buildings/ports projects.
* Requires proficiency in the application of architectural design standards, practices, and techniques, as well as a demonstrated proficiency in sketching, rendering, model building, and presentation drawing.
* Ability to communicate in English.
* Proficiency in Revit or other software packages typically associated with architectural design is also required.
* Acumen for reviewing designs and construction plans to meet codes, budgets, and schedules.

title: Senior Design Architect (Arabic)
description:
We are seeking a Senior Design Architect to lead architectural design development for villas, residential, and mixed-use projects, providing design direction, technical guidance, and client and authority liaison in Arabic and English.

Key Responsibilities:
* Lead the development of architectural design concepts, schematic designs, and detailed design packages.
* Review and approve CAD drawings, renderings, layouts, and construction documents prepared by junior architects and drafters.
* Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, and client requirements.
* Liaise with clients and government authorities (in Arabic and English) to present designs and secure approvals.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior architects and drafters on project teams.
* Write construction specifications and coordinate with engineering and construction teams.
* Review, approve, and issue detailed design and construction drawings prepared by others.
* Provide the seal and signature of a professional architect when required by statute or contract.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture (Master's preferred).
* Fluency in Arabic and English, spoken and written.
* Proficiency in Revit and other architectural design software.
* Strong leadership, presentation, and client-facing skills.
* Sound knowledge of local authority design and approval processes.

title: Junior Structural Engineer (DM G+4 License)
description:
We are seeking a skilled Structural Engineer to join our team and support the Senior Structural Engineer/Lead CSA in the preparation of concept, schematic, and detailed designs.

Key Responsibilities:
* Collaborate with the team under the guidance of the Senior Structural Engineer / Lead CSA.
* Contribute to the preparation of concept, schematic, and detailed designs.
* Provide technical expertise and assist in various stages of project design.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering.
* Proficiency in analytical and design software such as STAAD Pro, ETABS, SAP2000, Tekla, and IDEA StatiCa.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Experience with design and analysis of structural systems is a plus.
* With G+4 License (mandatory).

title: Structural BIM Modeler
description:
We are seeking a talented Structural BIM Modeler to join our engineering team. The candidate will be responsible for creating and managing detailed 3D BIM models for structural systems to support design coordination and project delivery.

Key Responsibilities:
* Develop, update, and maintain accurate 3D BIM models for structural systems including foundations, concrete, and steel structures.
* Collaborate with architects, engineers, and other disciplines to ensure proper model coordination and clash detection.
* Generate detailed drawings, schedules, and reports derived from the BIM models.
* Ensure all structural models comply with project requirements, standards, and codes.
* Support the preparation of technical documents and as-built models.
* Assist project teams during design reviews and construction phases.
* Use BIM tools such as Revit Structure, Tekla, Navisworks, and other relevant software.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Civil/Structural Engineering or related field.
* Proficient in BIM software (Revit Structure, Tekla, Navisworks).
* Strong knowledge of structural systems and construction.
* Excellent teamwork and communication skills.
* Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving capabilities.

title: Infrastructure Draftsman
description:
We are seeking an Infrastructure Draftsman (immediate joiner) to prepare detailed infrastructure and roads drawings for our Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah projects.

Key Responsibilities:
* Prepare infrastructure drawings — roads, utilities, drainage and grading — using AutoCAD and Civil 3D.
* Produce WGS84-format drawings with precise coordinates.
* Develop ITC / RTA traffic detour plans.
* Draft infrastructure utility services with precise coordinates.
* Prepare cross-section drawings.
* Incorporate engineers' design revisions and authority comments into drawings.
* Prepare drawing submissions for authority approvals and maintain drawing registers.
requirements:
* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field.
* Software proficiency: AutoCAD and Civil 3D.
* Skills: WGS84-format drawings, ITC/RTA traffic detour plans, infrastructure utility service drafting with precise coordinates, and cross-section drawings.
* Good understanding of infrastructure design standards and UAE authority requirements.
* Immediate joiner preferred; position based in Dubai / Abu Dhabi / Sharjah.

title: Infrastructure NOC Coordinator
description: Coordinate NOC applications and infrastructure approvals with government authorities for civil, road, and utility projects across Abu Dhabi and Dubai.
requirements:
* Preferably Arabic Nationality, not mandatory.
* Having 2 to 4 years' experience.
* Dubai G+4 Certified Engineer (Civil/Architectural).

Mandatory Requirement:
* Bachelors' degree in Arch or Civil Engineering or any relevant engineering discipline.
* 2 - 4 years' experience in liaising and dealing with the approval process related to infrastructure projects related to Civil, Road, bridges, interchanges, underpass, utilities (wet & electrical), landscape, sewerage, deep tunneling, NDRC, Thrust Boring, Pipe Jacking, underground utility structures with the specific statutory relevant authorities / stakeholders in Abu Dhabi Emirate.
* Have crystal clear understanding of Authority processes, procedures and policies and ensure that these are adhered to during the design submission and review process.
* Broad technical understanding of villas, building, infrastructure and fit out project sub-disciplines.
* Proficient in using CAD.

Preferable Requirement (not mandatory):
* Project Closeout preferable, not mandatory.
* Construction Contractual writing skill with fair knowledge of FIDIC Clauses, preferable, not mandatory.
* Ability to handle, review and respond to Contractor Submittals, RFI, SCR preferable, not mandatory.
* Ability to identify and address Project variation scope and change management with claim strategy, preferable, not mandatory.
* Ability to effectively communicate at all levels including external stakeholder. Excellent interpersonal skills, with high competency in listening and communicating.
* Time management ability, competence in prioritizing tasks and workload, ability to work in fast paced Project Environment.

title: Authority Liaison cum Coordinator
description: 2 - 4 years' experience in liaising and dealing with the approval process related to infrastructure projects related to Civil, Road, bridges, interchanges, underpass, utilities (wet & electrical), landscape, sewerage, deep tunneling, NDRC, Thrust Boring, Pipe Jacking, underground utility structures with the specific statutory relevant authorities / stakeholders in Abu Dhabi Emirate.
requirements:
Mandatory Requirement:
* Bachelors' degree in Arch or Civil Engineering or any relevant engineering discipline.
* Have crystal clear understanding of Authority processes, procedures and policies and ensure that these are adhered to during the design submission and review process.
* Broad technical understanding of villas, building, infrastructure and fit out project sub-disciplines.
* Proficient in using CAD.

Preferable Requirement (not mandatory):
* Project Closeout preferable, not mandatory.
* Construction Contractual writing skill with fair knowledge of FIDIC Clauses, preferable, not mandatory.
* Ability to handle, review and respond to Contractor Submittals, RFI, SCR preferable, not mandatory.
* Ability to identify and address Project variation scope and change management with claim strategy, preferable, not mandatory.
* Ability to effectively communicate at all levels including external stakeholder. Excellent interpersonal skills, with high competency in listening and communicating.
* Time management ability, competence in prioritizing tasks and workload, ability to work in fast paced Project Environment.
* Salary will be determined based on experience.

title: Piping Stress Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Piping Stress Engineer (immediate joiner) to carry out stress and flexibility analysis for piping systems across our Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah projects, ensuring designs meet code and operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities:
* Perform piping stress and flexibility analysis using CAESAR II for static and dynamic load cases.
* Carry out hydraulic analysis and prepare piping layouts and fabrication drawings.
* Model piping in SP3D and produce drawings in AutoCAD.
* Analyse piping for thermal, sustained, occasional and seismic loads per ASME B31.3 and applicable codes.
* Design and check pipe supports, springs and expansion joints.
* Evaluate equipment nozzle loads and coordinate with the mechanical and process teams.
* Prepare stress analysis reports, calculations and critical line lists.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering.
* Software knowledge: CAESAR II, AutoCAD, SP3D and Pipe Flow Expert.
* Skills: pipe stress analysis, hydraulic analysis, and preparation of piping layouts / fabrication drawings.
* Strong knowledge of ASME B31.3 and related piping codes.
* Immediate joiner preferred; position based in Dubai / Abu Dhabi / Sharjah.

title: Authority Architect
description:
We are seeking an Authority Architect to manage architectural design submissions and secure approvals from local authorities, acting as the key liaison between the design team and government departments.

Key Responsibilities:
* Prepare and compile architectural submission packages for authority approvals (municipality, civil defence, and other stakeholders).
* Review drawings for compliance with local building codes, regulations, and authority requirements before submission.
* Liaise with authorities to track applications, respond to comments, and obtain NOCs and permits.
* Coordinate with the internal design team to incorporate authority comments into drawings.
* Maintain submission registers and approval status logs.
* Stay current with changes in authority regulations and circulars.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture.
* Experience liaising with UAE authorities on building/architectural approvals.
* Strong knowledge of local building codes and authority submission processes.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and Revit.
* Excellent coordination and communication skills.

title: Structural (Design) Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Structural Design Engineer to perform structural analysis and design for buildings and infrastructure projects, from concept through detailed design, in coordination with multidisciplinary teams.

Key Responsibilities:
* Perform structural analysis and design of concrete and steel structures for villas, buildings, and infrastructure.
* Prepare design calculations, drawings, and specifications in line with applicable codes (ACI, BS, Eurocode) and local authority requirements.
* Use analysis software such as ETABS, STAAD Pro, SAFE, and SAP2000.
* Coordinate with architectural, MEP, and infrastructure teams to integrate structural solutions.
* Review shop drawings, submittals, and as-built documentation.
* Support authority submissions and respond to design comments.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Civil/Structural Engineering.
* Proven structural design experience on buildings and/or infrastructure.
* Proficiency in ETABS, STAAD Pro, SAFE, and SAP2000.
* Sound knowledge of design codes and UAE authority requirements.
* Strong analytical and coordination skills.

title: Senior / Mid-Level Architect
description:
We are seeking a Senior / Mid-Level Architect to lead and develop architectural designs for residential, commercial, and mixed-use projects from concept through detailed design and construction support.

Key Responsibilities:
* Develop architectural concepts, schematic designs, and detailed design packages.
* Prepare and review drawings, layouts, and construction documents for quality and code compliance.
* Coordinate with structural, MEP, and authority teams throughout the design stages.
* Produce design presentations and address client feedback and revisions.
* Guide and review the work of junior architects and drafters.
* Support authority submissions and site queries during construction.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture.
* 4+ years' architectural design experience (mid to senior level).
* Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, and visualization tools.
* Strong design, presentation, and coordination skills.
* Knowledge of UAE codes and authority approval processes.

title: Authority Architect - ADM Card Holder
description:
We are seeking an Authority Architect who holds a valid Abu Dhabi Municipality (ADM) card to manage architectural approvals and act as the registered liaison for submissions to Abu Dhabi authorities.

Key Responsibilities:
* Prepare and submit architectural packages to Abu Dhabi Municipality and related authorities using your ADM card.
* Review drawings for compliance with ADM regulations, building codes, and DCRM requirements.
* Liaise with authorities to obtain approvals, NOCs, and permits, and respond to comments.
* Coordinate with the design team to close out authority comments.
* Maintain submission and approval registers.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture.
* Valid Abu Dhabi Municipality (ADM) engineer/architect card (mandatory).
* Experience with Abu Dhabi authority submission and approval processes.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and Revit.
* Strong coordination and communication skills.

title: Senior Structural Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Structural Engineer to lead the structural design of buildings and infrastructure projects, providing technical direction and mentoring to the structural team.

Key Responsibilities:
* Lead structural analysis and design of concrete and steel structures from concept to detailed design.
* Review and approve calculations, drawings, and specifications prepared by the team.
* Ensure designs comply with applicable codes and local authority requirements.
* Coordinate with architectural, MEP, and infrastructure disciplines.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior structural engineers.
* Support authority submissions and resolve design queries during construction.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Civil/Structural Engineering (Master's preferred).
* 7+ years' structural design experience, including UAE projects.
* Proficiency in ETABS, STAAD Pro, SAFE, SAP2000, and Tekla.
* Strong knowledge of design codes and authority processes.
* Leadership and coordination skills; G+4 or higher license is an advantage.

title: Authority Engineer - Sharjah Municipality Engineering Card Holder
description:
We are seeking an Authority Engineer holding a valid Sharjah Municipality engineering card to manage engineering submissions and approvals with Sharjah authorities.

Key Responsibilities:
* Prepare and submit engineering packages to Sharjah Municipality and related authorities using your engineering card.
* Review drawings for compliance with Sharjah Municipality regulations and codes.
* Liaise with authorities to obtain approvals, NOCs, and permits, and respond to comments.
* Coordinate with the internal design team to close out authority comments.
* Maintain submission and approval registers.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Civil/Structural or a relevant engineering discipline.
* Valid Sharjah Municipality engineering card (mandatory).
* Experience with Sharjah authority submission and approval processes.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD; knowledge of Revit is an advantage.
* Strong coordination and communication skills.

title: Civil Quantity Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Civil Quantity Engineer (Quantity Surveyor) to handle quantity take-offs, BOQs, and cost control for civil and structural works across our projects.

Key Responsibilities:
* Prepare quantity take-offs and bills of quantities (BOQ) from drawings for civil and structural works.
* Support tendering with cost estimates, pricing, and comparison of subcontractor quotations.
* Measure and value work done for interim payments and variations.
* Review and assess contractor claims and change orders.
* Maintain cost records and support budget monitoring and reporting.
* Coordinate with design, procurement, and project teams.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or Quantity Surveying.
* Experience in quantity surveying/estimation for civil and structural works.
* Proficiency in measurement, BOQ preparation, and MS Excel.
* Knowledge of FIDIC and construction contracts is an advantage.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills.

title: Site Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Site Engineer to oversee site execution and ensure works are delivered in line with design, quality, and safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities:
* Supervise site activities and ensure works are executed per approved drawings and specifications.
* Coordinate with contractors, consultants, and the design team on site issues and RFIs.
* Monitor quality, progress, and compliance with HSE requirements.
* Review shop drawings and verify setting-out and construction methods.
* Prepare site reports, inspection requests, and progress records.
* Support resolution of technical issues during construction.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering.
* Site supervision experience on building/infrastructure projects.
* Good knowledge of construction methods, quality, and safety standards.
* Ability to read and interpret drawings and specifications.
* Strong coordination and reporting skills.

title: Senior Structural Engineer - Sharjah Municipality Engineering Card Holder
description:
We are seeking a Senior Structural Engineer holding a valid Sharjah Municipality engineering card to lead structural design and manage approvals for projects in Sharjah.

Key Responsibilities:
* Lead structural analysis and design of concrete and steel structures from concept to detailed design.
* Prepare and submit structural packages to Sharjah Municipality using your engineering card.
* Review and approve calculations, drawings, and specifications prepared by the team.
* Liaise with Sharjah authorities to obtain approvals and respond to comments.
* Coordinate with architectural, MEP, and infrastructure disciplines.
* Provide technical guidance to junior engineers.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Civil/Structural Engineering (Master's preferred).
* Valid Sharjah Municipality engineering card (mandatory).
* 7+ years' structural design experience, including Sharjah projects.
* Proficiency in ETABS, STAAD Pro, SAFE, and SAP2000.
* Strong knowledge of codes and Sharjah authority processes.

title: Web Developer
description:
We are seeking a Web Developer to build and maintain the company's websites and web applications, delivering fast, responsive, and secure digital experiences.

Key Responsibilities:
* Develop, maintain, and enhance websites and web applications.
* Implement responsive, cross-browser front-end interfaces from designs.
* Build and integrate back-end features, APIs, and databases.
* Optimize performance, SEO, and security.
* Troubleshoot and fix bugs, and support content updates.
* Collaborate with marketing and design on digital initiatives.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and a modern framework.
* Familiarity with back-end development, databases, and APIs (Node.js/PHP or similar).
* Understanding of responsive design, SEO, and web security.
* Good problem-solving and collaboration skills.

title: Executive Secretary cum Receptionist
description:
We are seeking an Executive Secretary cum Receptionist to provide executive administrative support and manage front-desk and reception duties.

Key Responsibilities:
* Manage the reception area, greet visitors, and handle incoming calls and correspondence.
* Provide secretarial support to management, including scheduling, meetings, and travel arrangements.
* Draft and manage letters, emails, documents, and records.
* Coordinate couriers, office supplies, and general administrative tasks.
* Maintain filing systems and confidential records.
* Support the team with day-to-day office coordination.
requirements:
* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Business Administration or a related field.
* Experience as an executive secretary, receptionist, or administrative assistant.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
* Excellent English communication and organizational skills.
* Professional, presentable, and well-organized.
